permits.project_name: SPANISH WELLS ENTRY IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT NARRATIVE - The Spanish Wells community is proposing to renovate their existing entry signage and widen Spanish Wells Road at the community entrance to 24’. The existing drive into the community currently pinches down between two stucco columns to approximately 15’-6”, creating potential hazards for motorist. The existing columns, walls and signage will be demolished to accommodate widening the drive. New brick columns, walls, landscape and signage are proposed to enhance the arrival experience into the community. Proposed site lighting includes low voltage uplights on the sign face and decorative column lights (similar to the existing column mounted fixtures). The vehicular turnaround in front of the entry columns will be maintained, and does not extend beyond the existing pavement footprint, and no trees will be impacted by the proposed improvements.

The proposed redevelopment of the circle center shopping center consists of upgrades to the existing center façade, replacement and expansion of the existing grocery store, and associated parking and utility infrastructure improvements. The parking improvements within the front parking area are intended to update the existing parking spaces and drive aisle widths in order to be better aligned with best practices for the grocery store customer needs. The proposed 1 story (with mezzanine) ±51,660 sf grocer and ±1,562 sf retail result in an increase of ±6,667 sf of building area. The proposed improvements approximately decrease impervious area by ±0.2 acre. All improvements on site will remain to be owned and maintained by the property owner, Bre Retail Residual Circle Center Owners LLC. there are no apparent wetlands on site.
The overall project disturbed area is 4.5 acres.

permits.project_name: Beaufort County School District plans to rebuild the existing Hilton Head Island High School building at the same location, to replace the existing facility.  The existing school facility was built in 1983, has since undergone several smaller additions and renovations, and is approximately 231,768 SF.  The new school will be constructed in phases to allow the school to remain operational throughout the duration of construction.  The first phase is intended to include constructing a new 3-story wing at existing parking while the existing school remains operational. Phase 2 will follow as a separate project to include demolishing a portion of the existing building in leu of replacement parking while students can transition into the first phase wing, followed by lastly re-working/ renovating the remaining portion of the existing school.  The proposed work is not intended to increase the student capacity, but maintain the existing approximately 1,300 student capacity.  Other site-related work such as improvements to Wilborn Road, parking, and landscaping is also intended as part of this development.
